set.n: Bogus Island counterfeiters' cave, swamp near Leoni
set.pl: Swamp near Leoni (GNIS Leoni village), Jackson County; "Bogus Island" not in GNIS (Jackson Citizen Patriot 1933)
pinev: Village-level: the Jackson Citizen Patriot of 19 Sep 1933 says the swamp where an air-mail plane crashed was known around Leoni as Bogus Island; pin at GNIS Leoni (about 3 km).
set.st: Bogus Island, once ringed by water in the great Portage Marsh near the Michigan Central RR, was the 1849 base of a gang of counterfeiters who made bogus coin in a cave by a knoll in the centre until federal agents took 8-10 of them. In 1933 the Jackson paper placed it in the swamp near Leoni where an air-mail plane crashed; the cave was later filled in. Pin is approximate, not the spot itself.
set.t: Swamp near Leoni. The cave by the central knoll was later filled in. No hidden money claimed so far: record only. Private: permission.
